The '''Forced Retirement Home''' was a sector of [[Shadow Town]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Forced Retirement Home appears as part of Shadow Town on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
